comment: Every merged upstream PR, newest first, with the note shown in the ledger. highlight marks the default 'Highlights' view. The pipeline re-verifies every state daily and appends merges not listed here automatically (without a note).

curated.note: Checking whether another URI of a liked recording was saved walked every saved song, for every track on every page. It now asks the recording's own few URIs: a 50-track page after 20k likes drops from 46.7 ms to 0.04 ms.
Loading Liked Songs cloned, compared and rebuilt the whole list for every 50-song page. Pages that land at the end are now appended, taking 20,000 songs from 3.95 s to 0.44 s.

Median and Dust & Scratches gathered a whole disc of samples per pixel, so each doubling of the radius cost 4x. A rank histogram sliding over each tile makes it linear: radius 32 on 1920x1280 drops from 48 s to 0.84 s, bit-identical.
Motion Blur took an edge-checked bilinear sample per step for every pixel. One merged kernel now runs over whole rows: 6x to 71x faster, with at most one 8-bit level of difference.
Fractional sizes were summed digit by digit with truncating division, so fallocate -l 1.7G made a 2 GiB file, and a fraction like .10 was off by 10x. The fraction is now computed exactly.

Tree mode asked PID 1 about the same unit again for every path that reached it. Caching each answer per unit takes systemctl list-dependencies --all from 63.6 s to 0.34 s, byte-for-byte identical output.
document.pixel panicked at x or y = i32::MAX, and coordinates past 32 bits silently wrapped to column 0. Out-of-range coordinates are now an error and the edge pixel reads as transparent.
Surface Blur summed the full window for every pixel, over a minute at radius 100. On 8-bit layers a sliding 256-bin histogram does it in O(radius): 13x to about 150x faster.
Minimum and Maximum with Squareness scanned every sample in the window per pixel. Reusing the constant-time running extreme from Roundness makes it up to 37x faster at large radii, bit-identical.
Box Blur convolved a 2r+1 kernel per pixel, so cost grew with the radius. It now shares Gaussian Blur's running-sum passes: 26x faster at radius 400.

Every removed seam recomputed the full energy map and copied the whole image. Recomputing only the pixels beside the seam and shifting rows in place takes a seam from 319 ms to 23.6 ms, output unchanged.
Copying an image file in a file manager and pressing Ctrl+V did nothing, because only the path is on the clipboard. Paste now falls back to decoding the first image in the copied file list.
Enlarging a 1 px wide or tall layer in Content-Aware Scale panicked, because the seam loop gave up at width 1. A one-line guard fix lets that last column be duplicated.
cal -3 1 1 started at December 0000, and a span beginning exactly 12 months back read full_month[-1] and printed (null). One month index, clamped to January of year 1, fixes both.

report-files listed and looked up entries by different rules, so masking a vendor file with a /dev/null symlink dropped entries and logged warnings. The listing now filters masked entries and the lookup skips non-regular ones the same way.
setpriv accepted any prefix of a Landlock filesystem right, so a typo like fs:remove quietly gave a weaker sandbox than the one asked for. Now rejected.
Forced SipHash's round inline where gcc -O2 declined, making short-key hashing up to 6.6x faster across systemd's hashmaps.
Three fixes on journalctl's per-entry read path, including a UTF-8 decoder that ran twice per byte. Output is byte-for-byte identical, 1.7x to 2.5x faster.
The console-width helper used the permissive UTF-8 decoder, so one invalid cell failed a whole table with a bogus out-of-memory error.
column(1) mis-measured cells after any non-SGR escape sequence; the scan now stops at a real ECMA-48 CSI final byte.
Fixed both overflow guards in the load-average parser: one was inverted and one ran after the shift, so values from 2^53 up wrapped to 0.00 instead of being rejected.
One datagram with a bad checksum, sendable by anyone on the link, disabled resolved's mDNS, LLMNR or stub listener until restart.
A leaked reference let resolved free an mDNS service browser while its maintenance timer still used it: a use-after-free, fixed in one line.
Stopped unbounded buffer growth on truncated compressed streams, and added fuzzers that feed hostile input to every decompressor and to importd's qcow2 path.
ProxmoxVE configs with more than one nameserver left DNS unset at boot; now emits one dracut nameserver= per address, IPv6 bracketed.
Truncating a long multi-byte hostname split a UTF-8 character and panicked, failing afterburn-hostname.service at boot.
Re-landed Anthropic-native /v1/models after a staging revert, so Claude Code's model picker populates through a litellm gateway.
The line re-breaker dropped text before an embedded newline and returned entries spanning lines, which could emit uncommented lines in Varlink IDL output.
An empty long option (--=VALUE) prefix-matched every option, and with only one defined was silently accepted as it. Now rejected.
An NGRAM-indexed contains() with a needle under three characters returned zero rows; it now falls back to a full recheck.
An off-by-one skipped the last offset a two-byte escape sequence can start at, so ellipsize() over-truncated strings containing ESC M.
A newline in an ask-password prompt could inject a Socket= line and send the typed password to another path. Unsafe characters are now refused.
Prompts of 255+ bytes wrapped Plymouth's one-byte length field, so the rest of the prompt was parsed as protocol data. Now rejected with -EMSGSIZE.
A truncated multi-byte character at the end of a string made the line breaker step past the NUL terminator and read out of bounds.
\u escapes accepted UTF-16 surrogates and produced invalid UTF-8 downstream; now rejected, matching the \U form.
hostname_cleanup() stripped only one trailing separator, so foobar-- came back as the invalid hostname foobar-.
MRR fusion averaged only over the rankings a document appeared in, letting a single-system hit outrank a consensus pick.
Fixed incorrect reboot/pending logic in sysupdate when --component= is used. First PR merged into systemd.
Implemented Browser.setDownloadBehavior for CDP-driven file download automation.
Fixed incorrect evaluation of list-element docs in the FTS prefilter walk-the-allowlist branch.
Replaced panic paths in the Bedrock embedding provider with typed error returns across serialization, API, and runtime failure modes.
Fixed opaque AttributeError for bare List/Tuple generics in Pydantic schema conversion, raising a clear TypeError instead.
Enabled Anthropic-native model discovery for Claude Code gateway deployments.
Preserved cache_control headers for OpenAI-compatible custom endpoints, fixing silent cache bypass.
Surfaced max_input_tokens and max_output_tokens on /v1/models for accurate client-side capacity planning.
Critical fix: merge_insert silently dropped matched rows when the leading payload column was all-null.
Stopped a cancelled stream from stranding its max_parallel_requests slot, which had been pinning capped keys at their limit.
Added a proxy-wide setting to disable budget reservation.
Moved embedding search onto a dedicated executor to stop event-loop stalls.
Completed file-input support, from FileList through DOM.setFileInputFiles.
The same DataFusion capability carried into LanceDB's Rust core.
Stopped budget enforcement on model-discovery and info routes.
Build-system fix accepted into the reference Python implementation.
DataFusion expressions for merge-insert predicates in a production columnar format.
W3C File API surface implemented in Zig for an AI-agent headless browser.
